quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original sesame mushroom sandwich steaming on a dark slate board, with one clean gloved hand touching only the top bun. Return the complete sandwich to the same board and widen enough to prove its full silhouette. Reveal one fresh bite cross-section, then fade to the exact original line "BUILT IN LAYERS" beside the intact remaining sandwich.

invariants.rule: The complete food baseline is readable before any structural manipulation.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.rule: The product returns to a complete hero state after the detail proof.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The product returns to a complete hero state after the detail proof."

invariants.rule: A bounded press preserves rather than collapses the established structure.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A bounded press preserves rather than collapses the established structure."

invariants.rule: The terminal cross-section verifies internal layers before exact readable copy appears.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal cross-section verifies internal layers before exact readable copy appears."
